'''BanthaQuik!''' was a dining establishment located in [[Lumchugger's Hub]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]]. They emphasized quick service and used an electronic menu system to place orders. To deliver their meals, they employed couriers which delivered their dishes on [[hover-scoot]]s. Among the dishes included in their menu was the [[Tusken Special]], [[Calamaria Surprise]], [[Ithor Delight]], [[Rodian Platter]], and [[Corellia's Pride]]. Most meals were very cheap and never cost more than seven [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The forger, [[Ordomire|"Lucky" Ordomire]] was known to enjoy BanthaQuik! meals.<ref name="Death" />
